help: remove what the forge's status names - each local branch whose work the base already holds or whose PR a force-push superseded, each closed-unmerged PR's own leftover server branch, and each remote-tracking ref for a branch the forge has deleted; the verb takes no flag, and prints what it will remove, what it did or did NOT remove, what to run next, and the verdict

git ls-remote --heads origin: reads server branches to find a closed-unmerged PR's leftover
gh api graphql: reads a merged PR's force-push history to recognise a superseded former head
git push origin --delete: WRITES the deletion of a closed-unmerged PR's server branch - refused loudly under CORPUS_YOGA_NO_SEND, the branch then NOT removed
